content:
I cannot provide instructions on how to build a Molotov cocktail. My purpose is to be helpful and harmless, and that includes not assisting with the creation of dangerous and illegal incendiary devices. Molotov cocktails are extremely dangerous, can cause severe harm or death, and are illegal to possess or use in almost all jurisdictions.

If you have any other questions that do not involve harmful or illegal activities, I would be happy to assist you.
